description: This file implements the CloudStoreImplementation class, which registers a service, manages a Store2 object, and provides a configuration method for a plugin in the WPEFramework. It includes external headers for service registration and gRPC store functionality, and defines methods for construction, destruction, and configuration.

classes.name: CloudStoreImplementation
classes.description: A class that implements a cloud store service, manages a gRPC store object, and provides configuration capabilities within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the _accountStore2 member with a new Store2 service instance.

methods.description: Configures the cloud store by querying the IConfiguration interface and invoking its Configure method.
